answer.rationale: Degradation is confined to the primary region while a release went out globally 2 hours ago; a region-localized signal argues against the build being the root cause, making regional failover the better-supported move (memory_b2 shows fast latency recovery and clean traffic shift). However, failover during peak settlement write load carries risk of losing in-flight customer writes, so I want to verify the failover record's write-handling details (b2) and the rollback record (b1) as the fallback option before committing. If verification shows failover risks write loss at peak, I would switch to rollback_release.
